hook_text: Kyun suni Meera ne apni awaaz?
feedback: Great cold open using the flash-forward technique. Ensure the Hindi text uses natural conversational flow with everyday English words seamlessly blended. The eerie rural Birbhum atmosphere is well-captured through specific visual details like the brass lock and earthen diya.
lines: Par ye sab teen din pehle shuru hua.
Meera apne bimaar nani ke paas gaon aayi thi.
Dadi ne saaf kaha, 'Amavas ki raat darwaza mat kholna.'
Phir vo kaali Amavas ki raat aa gayi.
Bahar se rone ki awaaz aane lagi.
Jab Meera ne keyhole se jhaanka...
Usne mudkar andar kamre mein dekha.
Dadi toh shaam ko hi gehri neend mein ja chuki thhi.
Aur darwaze ke bahar vo chehra bina chehre ka thha.
Rooh ruk gayi thi taaki asli bala andar na aa sake.
Us raat Meera ne apni hi awaaz ko kuen se goonjte suna.
